Verity & Verity Increases Holding in Spectra Energy Partners LP (SEP); Angelo Gordon & Company LP Increased Stake in Monsanto Co New (MON) as Shares Rose
May 16, 2018 - By Vivian Park
John M. Angelo increased its stake in Monsanto Co New (MON) by 31.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Angelo Gordon & Company Lp bought 175,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.12% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by John M. Angelo held 725,000 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $84.67 million, up from 550,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Angelo Gordon & Company Lp who had been investing in Monsanto Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $55.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.02% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $125.26. About 366,922 shares traded. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 3.06% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.49% the S&P500.
Verity & Verity Llc increased its stake in Spectra Energy Partners Lp (SEP) by 53.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Verity & Verity Llc bought 11,830 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.17% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,144 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.35M, up from 22,314 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Verity & Verity Llc who had been investing in Spectra Energy Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.38% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $33.31. About 85,440 shares traded. Spectra Energy Partners, LP (NYSE:SEP) has declined 22.60% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.15% the S&P500.
